title: Tinker's Kitchen
description: Kitchen Knives that work with both Tinker's and Farmer's Delight, and a few new Tinker's-based foods.
body:
![A showcase of the items in the mod. Five pies are shown, as well as pizza, a cheese sandwich, and mac & cheese. A manyullyn knife is presented in the center of the screen.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/144bbc10ccba90e10cb1743a206bf6942e950317_0.webp)

**Tinker's Kitchen** primarilly adds a new tool to Tinker's Construct; the Kitchen Knife. This tool works as a knife for Farmer's Delight, as well as a weapon in its own right, and can be fully customized using the breadth of Tinker's. Ever wanted your knife to also store milk? Now you can!

![A screenshot of a kitchen knife being crafted. It is made using a Small Blade and a Tool Binding.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90273482706fa8b4b0b442f64ef82c8e52b0ee81.png)

Also added by the mod are a few new foods, made using Tinker's materials. Enjoy new cheese-based dishes like pizza or mac & cheese, as well as esoteric options like the new slime-based pies.

*I also recommend the unrelated [Tinker's Construct Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkers-construct-delight), which is a great mod that adds even more Tinker's-related foods to the game.*

**NOTE:** The source code to this mod is currently unavailable due to a GitHub error. Once possible, a link will be added. Thank you for understanding
